xml.brief: Mark a geocache as temporarily unavailable

desc.p: The owner marks the geocache as temporarily unavailable, e.g. while it waits for maintenance.

This is a shortcut for services/logs/submit with logtype "Temporarily unavailable": it publishes the same status log entry, with the same rules and the same result, on every installation. Only the owner of the geocache may change its status.

opt.name: comment
opt.p: Text of the status log entry, as in services/logs/submit.

opt.name: langpref
opt.p: Language of the message returned, as in services/logs/submit.

returns.p: The same dictionary as services/logs/submit returns (success, message, log_uuid, log_uuids). As there, a refused status change is success false with a message for the user, not an HTTP error.
